description: This file defines the VirtualInput class and related classes/interfaces for handling virtual input devices, key mappings, and input event processing within the Thunder PluginHost namespace. It includes classes for managing key modifiers, repeat timers, key mappings, and IPC-based input handling, with platform-specific subclasses for Linux input devices.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for virtual input device handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC communication.

classes.name: RepeatKeyTimer
classes.description: Handles timing for repeated key events, with reference counting and scheduling.

classes.name: KeyMap
classes.description: Manages key code to key mapping, including modifiers, import/export, and pass-through mode.

classes.name: KeyMapEntry
classes.description: Represents a single key mapping entry with code, key, and modifiers.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Iterates over consumers or key mappings.

classes.name: INotifier
classes.description: Interface for input event notification callbacks.

classes.name: PostLookupTable
classes.description: JSON container for key code conversion mappings.

classes.name: Conversion
classes.description: Represents a conversion rule between input and output key codes.

classes.name: KeyCode
classes.description: Defines a key code and associated modifiers for conversion.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: Handles IPC-based virtual input, including registration of input consumers and event dispatching.

classes.name: InputDataLink
classes.description: Represents a data link for IPC communication, with key code translation.

classes.name: VirtualInputChannelServer
classes.description: IPC channel server for IPCUserInput, managing client connections.

classes.name: InputHandler
classes.description: Manages initialization and deinitialization of input devices, supporting device and virtual types.
